thread:
Lina: Quick heads-up — we're trialing a new SI credentialing flow called Gatekeeper. Need sync on rubric + rollout timeline. who can join a short call today?
Raj: I can do 30m after lunch. want to run the assessment checklist and shipping timeline.
Marta: Putting draft rubric in this thread. it's a lightweight 3-step: knowledge quiz, lab demo, and 1-week shadow.
Jonas: Nice. for lab demo we should lock down the test harness image + a small inference workload (2 concurrent requests, 512 tokens).
Sam: +1 on workload. Also need to confirm which marketplace SKUs map to each credential level (starter / certified / partner).
Lina: rough timeline: pilot with 3 SIs in June, iterate in July, public launch in Aug. is that aggressive? :thinking_face:
Raj: June pilot ok if we have grading automation for the knowledge quiz. can marta add auto-scorer questions?
Marta: yes — quiz will be multiple choice + 2 short answers. auto-scorer for MC, manual review for short answers. grading rubric below:
```
Gatekeeper Rubric v0.1
- Knowledge quiz (40%): >=80% auto-pass
- Lab demo (40%): live demo score >= 70% (per checklist)
- Shadow week (20%): mentor rating >= 3/5
Pass threshold: weighted score >= 75%
```
Raj: can we make the lab checklist deterministic? sample items: deploy model, run perf test, validate kv-cache behavior, simulate fallback routing.
Jonas: adding concrete commands for the lab so reviewers run the same steps. e.g.:
```
# spin up test env
redwood-cli deploy --image si-gatekeeper:test --mode isolated
# run workload
curl -X POST https://test.redwood/api/generate -d '{"prompt":"<test>","max_tokens":512}'\n
```
Sam: we'll need a marketplace SKU mapping doc and a one-pager for customers explaining what each credential means. i can draft the one-pager.
Lina: action items:
- Marta: finalize quiz + auto-scorer by Thu (1755910000)
- Jonas: write deterministic lab commands + harness by Fri
- Sam: draft SKU mapping + one-pager by next Tue
- Raj: schedule pilot kickoff with the 3 SI PMs (include mentor assign)
Raj: scheduled — will ping invites after this thread.
Marta: quick Q — do we want proctoring during the lab demo or allow recorded sessions?
Jonas: allow recorded sessions for asynchronous review for timezone reasons, but require one live verification step (5–10m).
Lina: agreed. keep live verification light.
Sam: FYI — finance asked to map certification pricing tiers. i'll loop in finance in the next message.
deploy-bot: Reminder: new channel doc created -> https://redwood.internal/docs/si-gatekeeper (auto-generated) :page_with_curl: 
Lina: thanks all. once Marta drops the rubric I'll post pilot candidate list and mentor pairings. :rocket:
